## CHOLECYSTITIS
[Oral step-down treatment](orzid2-gmenu-abx-step-down-treatment)
Adequate biliary drainage is the definitive treatment. Antimicrobials should be
prescribed only if signs of infection like leukocytosis or fever are present or
if the patient is elderly. Surgery and Gastroenterology involvement are
essential.
For acute cholecystitis in grade 1 disease, antimicrobials are primarily
prophylactic. For moderate to severe disease grades 2-3, antimicrobials should
be continued for 4-7 days.
Most cases are associated with E. coli, Enterococcus, Klebsiella, and
Enterobacter. Anaerobic coverage is not indicated unless a biliary-enteric
abnormality is present. For community-acquired acute cholecystitis, enterococcal
coverage is not required because Enterococcus has not been shown to be
pathogenic in these patients
Due to increasing resistance, fluoroquinolones are only recommended in cases of
severe penicillin and cephalosporin allergy.
## Treatment of patient on ward without systemic symptoms of infection
Duration of Therapy: Antimicrobials should be discontinued within 24 hours of
drainage procedure
[Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h [R]](psjizid-cefazolin-2gm-ivpb-q8h)
Biliary structural abnormality, including stent:
[< ADD > Metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI] to above regimen](psjizid-metronidazole-500-mg-iv-q8h)
## Treatment of patient on ward with systemic symptoms of infection
Duration of Therapy: Treat for 4-7 days after source control
Preferred:
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q6h [R]](psjizid-pip-taz-3-375-gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)
Alternative:
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M]](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)
Biliary structural abnormality, including stent:
< ADD > Metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI] to one of the regimens above
Alternative for severe beta-lactam reaction:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)
[Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]](orz-set-abx-levofloxacin-750mg-iv-and-metro-500mg-iv)
## Treatment of ICU patients
## Inpatient Duration of Therapy: Most can be treated for 4-7 days after source control.
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R]](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)
< OR >
[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q12h [DI]](orz-set-abx-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h-metronidazole-500-mg-iv-q8h)
< OR >
[Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h [R,O]](psjizid-meropenem-1gm-iv-q8h)
